game.title: Battlefield 4
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter from Electronic Arts DICE (RAWG also lists Electronic Arts), published by Electronic Arts, released 2013-10-29. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genre: Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign missions and multiplayer content named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Campaign Missions
chapters.summary: The missions the achievements name: Baku, Shanghai, South China Sea, Singapore, Kunlun Mountains, Tashgar and Suez, with score targets and weapon feats for each.

chapters.title: The Valkyrie and the Endings
chapters.summary: The choice over the Valkyrie and all three endings. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Assignments and Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finding the 28 campaign collectibles, campaign assignments, and finishing on Easy, Normal and Hard.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Dog tag kills, every game mode, the M1911, Obliteration bombs and reaching rank 25.

chapters.title: China Rising
chapters.summary: China Rising assignments, Air Superiority, the dirtbike, the SUAV and the bomber.

chapters.title: Operation Metro, Caspian Border and Gulf of Oman
chapters.summary: Map feats on Operation Metro, Caspian Border and Gulf of Oman, and Capture the Flag.

chapters.title: Naval Strike
chapters.summary: Carrier Assault, the ACV, the highest point in Naval Strike, the AA Mine and the old cannon.

chapters.title: Dragon's Teeth
chapters.summary: Dragon's Teeth maps and assignments, Chainlink, the Ballistic Shield and the RAWR.

chapters.title: Final Stand
chapters.summary: Final Stand maps and assignments, the Titan Engines, the prototype weapons and one hidden achievement.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3842). RAWG lists five additions: China Rising, Second Assault, Naval Strike, Dragon's Teeth and Final Stand. Steam app 1238860 ("Battlefield 4™") was used. 1 of 67 Steam achievements is hidden: "Cold Blooded" (1.4%), which sits among the Final Stand achievements (GOSCC_63 to 67) in the list, so it was put in that chapter, a reasoned guess. The China Rising, Naval Strike, Dragon's Teeth and Final Stand chapters each hold a block of five achievements, and each block names its pack in at least one achievement or map ("Naval Strike" is named as a map). The block GOSCC_48 to 52 names Operation Metro, Caspian Border, Gulf of Oman and CTF but no pack; RAWG's "Second Assault" is the one addition not named by any achievement, but the data does not tie the two together, so that chapter is named for the maps. The campaign mission order is not in the data, so missions are listed as the achievements name them. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0 (marked as a stub): Controls, Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written; only its Table of Contents subpage exists, so nothing was used. battlefield.fandom.com answers the API under "Battlefield 4" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
